newsitem.title: UK: Lacklustre LME copper ends AM kerb at lows.
newsitem.headline: Lacklustre LME copper ends AM kerb at lows.

text.p: COPPER - Finishes slow midday session $2 easier at $2,279 after coming off early highs. Cash/threes backwardation touch wider at $36/$37.

ALUMINIUM - Slightly firmer, but attempt to extend early shortcovering gains runs out of steam. NICKEL - Fails to hold onto $7,400 level, eases $20 to $7,370. TIN - Stable. LEAD/ZINC - Touch easier. ALLOY - Indicated firmer.
